limitations: This frozen set holds out exact inputs and prompt templates, not operation semantics: name, stem, suffix, parent, with_name, with_stem, and with_suffix all occur in training or development. It cannot support a claim of independent semantics, broad Python expertise, filesystem behavior, cross-platform path behavior, or any memory/architecture advantage. It must not select a checkpoint, seed, or rerun. The 0.0 controls are deliberate non-claims: this finite authored oracle-answer pool supplies no open-vocabulary chance baseline. Literal scoring trims only outer reply whitespace; case, Unicode composition, and internal whitespace remain significant.
